exposure: Mode of birth (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 7,174,787 singleton live births from Denmark, Scotland, England, and Australia (New South Wales and Western Australia) between 1996 and 2015
finding: Birth by cesarean section was consistently associated with increased risk of infection-related hospitalisation in early childhood, regardless of whether the cesarean was elective or emergency.
country: Australia (New South Wales and Western Australia)
